POST requires reviewed reviewHash; no fallback that silently accepts missing hash.
GET review A, mutate source, POST A hash ->409/no share; fresh GET/hash then exact selected IDs/inclusions create immutable snapshot.
Real todos/provenance where existing APIs support.
Review exact share snapshot, authoritative recipient users, list/revoke.
Real artifacts/MCP resources where existing APIs support.

Safe real sandbox exact-review share with two synthetic users, stale conflict, recipient read and revoke
Durable screenshots for exact share review and isolated Inspector resource preview
